query: SELECT to_jsonb(j) AS "value!" FROM agent_conversation_turns j WHERE state = 'queued' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_conversation_turns other WHERE other.session_id = j.session_id AND (other.state IN ('running', 'interrupted') OR (other.state = 'queued' AND (other.created_at, other.source_message_id) < (j.created_at, j.source_message_id)))) ORDER BY created_at, source_message_id LIMIT $1
